authorized_by: User request to diagnose missingness and consider conservative observed-minimum substitutions with mean sensitivity
scope: Five selected City standardized score columns only; Census suppression is not imputed
orientation: higher_is_better for the published evaluation scores; a policy interpretation, not a claim that higher raw speed indicates greater need
minimum_definition: Minimum finite observed value in the same published column; not a theoretical bound on standardized scores or unknown corridor values
source_preservation: Never replace values in city_standardized_scores_v0.1.csv or its published-score archive
provenance_contract: Every substitution must correspond to an originally blank cell, carry a per-cell flag and match the recomputed column statistic. Observed cells must remain unchanged.
missingness_interpretation: Concentrated in seven corridors with repeated indicator patterns; not treated as random missingness. Existing-service gaps may be structural and exact source causes still require review.
bias_warning: Assigning the observed minimum can penalize proposed/extension corridors because existing service is unavailable; it is a declared scenario assumption, not a guaranteed conservative lower bound or an unbiased estimate.
diagnostic_weights: Equal weights across the five City columns only; no equity input and no final corridor recommendation
admission_policy: Complete scenario values do not establish baseline, geographic or temporal comparability. No missing-value bypass based only on a notes string.
